name: Side Plank

instructions.description: Lie on one side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked or staggered.
Brace your trunk and lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Keep the chest open and avoid letting the top shoulder roll forward.
Lower with control and repeat on the other side.

performanceMetrics.notes: Hold each side for the prescribed time.

variations.variationDescription: Emphasizes lateral trunk stability instead of a front-facing anti-extension hold.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Bend the knees to shorten the lever and reduce difficulty.

commentsNotes: Push the floor away with the supporting arm.
